manufacturer.name: Dooya
manufacturer.note: Ningbo Dooya Mechanic & Electronic Technology - Chinese tubular motor manufacturer for roller blinds and shutters, widely rebadged. The only dooya domain that surfaced is an Indian product page, not a documentation index, so supportUrl is null. Documents below are a regulatory filing, a distributor copy and aggregator listings.

documents.title: Dooya DC Standard Tubular Motor Installation and Specification Guide
documents.evidence: Recorded from a web search result naming this URL as "Dooya DC Standard Tubular Motor Installation and Specification Guide" (host: manuals.plus). Neither the document nor the page has been opened, so its presence at this URL, its edition and its contents are all unconfirmed. Treat as a lead, not a citation, until manuals:verify has run against it. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Dooya DM350328 Tubular Motor User Manual (FCC filing)
documents.evidence: The manual as filed with the FCC under grantee code VYY, mirrored by fccid.io. That makes it the manufacturer's own document in a regulatory record, but the host is a third-party mirror of public filings, not Dooya - so origin stays third-party. Region is US because an FCC filing is a US regulatory document, not because the motor is US-only. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Dooya Manual Override Tubular Motor Instructions
documents.evidence: Distributor copy, filed by Rollac under wiring diagrams and limit-switch adjustments. Covers the manual-override variant. The file name does not carry a model code, so it is attached to the DM35 series on the strength of the directory naming it Dooya Motors - that attribution is weaker than the others here and should be checked when the link is verified. Not fetched - egress blocked.
